digest.component_or_area: Jira DC integration — capability detection, field validation, inbound probe port
propositions: Post-run Epic-field contract validation refuses to vouch for capability maps it cannot verify after agent execution, exiting non-zero with verdict in run_metadata.json

Runtime capability call sites are guarded with isinstance-primary logic plus hasattr fallback, and capability-absent vs capability-raised are reported distinctly on bridge_alerts rather than silently swallowed
Dormant inbound absence-probe port and its related units (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, probe_remote implementations) are deleted from the codebase

Three acceptance criteria were amended during delivery: post-run validation premise (not pre-run), distinct skip-vs-failure reporting (not hard failure), and non-regression baseline (pre-existing harness red from commit c87afedba8, fixed separately on ticket 9590)
No unit test, live DC harness cell, or pytest marker was deleted, skipped, or xfail'd to reach green during this epic's three commits
Guard shape diverges from ADR-0083's isinstance-only guidance due to Python 3.12 getattr_static behavior with __getattr__-proxying transports, tracked as follow-up on ticket 5c21
